blurb: Guests visit a brewery housed in a 120-year old Nabisco Factory with original architectural features. The bar features a 1920s meets 2020s theme with jazz and hip-hop murals. The brewery offers a variety of craft beers including IPAs and lagers, and partners with local charities and artists.
extraNote: Allow outside food from home, delivery, or restaurants · Dogs allowed indoors if well behaved and leashed · Patio seating is first come, first serve · Private events available with full buyout on normally closed days (Mon, Tue, before 4pm weekdays) · Partial buyouts available during open hours
